description: Seen 2026-10-25 in the full gate at 840fe346, load 13.5: doorbell::a_post_while_its_agent_restarts_waits_for_the_resumed_agent failed at crates/muster-daemon/tests/daemon/doorbell.rs:1286, the post answered Woken (p1 idle) where the test expects Deferred, then a harness request went unanswered for 20 s.
